chapters.zh: 线性代数中的线性方程组

topics.focus: Identify linear systems, translate between a system and its augmented/coefficient matrix, and decide consistency (no solution / one / infinitely many).
topics.focus_zh: 判断线性方程组、方程组与增广矩阵/系数矩阵互译、判断相容性（无解 / 唯一解 / 无穷多解）。
steps: Write each equation as a1x1 + ... + anxn = b; reject any term such as x^2, xy, sin x or 1/x.
Build the coefficient matrix A and the augmented matrix [A | b], with rows = equations and columns = variables.
Apply the three elementary row operations (replacement, scaling, interchange) to reach a triangular form; they are reversible and preserve the solution set.
Back-substitute to obtain the solution; a row [0 ... 0 | c] with c != 0 means the system is inconsistent.
topics.note: 增广矩阵最后一列是常数项 $b$，系数矩阵只含 $a_{ij}$。二维几何解释：两直线相交得唯一解、平行无解、重合无穷多解。两个基本问题：是否相容（consistent）？解是否唯一？初等行变换得到等价方程组，解集不变。
topics.trap: Dropping the constant column; applying a row operation to the coefficient side but not the right-hand side; reading 0 = 0 as an inconsistency.
topics.trap_zh: 列增广矩阵时漏掉常数项列；行变换只对左端系数做、忘记对右端 $b$ 做同样操作；把 $0=0$ 误判为无解。
topics.question_hint: Translate a system to/from an augmented matrix; identify whether an equation is linear; decide consistent / inconsistent / infinitely many solutions; perform a given elementary row operation.

topics.focus: Row reduce a matrix to echelon form (REF) and reduced echelon form (RREF), locate pivots, and write the general solution in parametric form.
topics.focus_zh: 行化简到阶梯形 REF 与最简阶梯形 RREF、定位主元与主元列、区分基本变量与自由变量并写出参数形式通解。
steps: Start with the leftmost nonzero column, choose a nonzero pivot and use interchange to move it up into the pivot position.
Use replacement to create zeros below each pivot, then repeat on the remaining submatrix (forward phase) to get REF.
For RREF, scale each pivot row so the pivot becomes 1, then create zeros above each pivot (backward phase).
Mark pivot columns (basic variables) and the other columns (free variables); solve each basic variable in terms of the free ones and write x = p + t*u + s*v.
Apply the Existence and Uniqueness Theorem (Theorem 2): the system is consistent iff the augmented column is NOT a pivot column; infinitely many solutions iff at least one free variable exists.
topics.note: REF 三条件：非零行在零行之上、每行主元在上一行主元右侧、主元下方全为 0；RREF 额外要求主元全为 1 且所在列其余元素为 0。RREF 唯一（Uniqueness of the Reduced Echelon Form）。主元个数等于矩阵秩，自由变量个数为 $n$ 减秩。存在唯一性定理：$A$ 与 $[A|b]$ 秩相等才相容。
topics.trap: Confusing REF with RREF; labelling a free variable as basic; deciding consistency before checking whether the rightmost column is a pivot column.
topics.trap_zh: 混淆 REF 与 RREF；把自由变量当成基本变量；未检查增广列是否为主元列就断言相容（出现 $[0|5]$ 即 $0=5$，无解）。
topics.question_hint: Identify whether a matrix is in echelon / reduced echelon form; row reduce to REF or RREF; find pivots, basic and free variables; write the general solution; find k (or a) so the system is consistent or has a given number of solutions.

topics.focus: Work with vectors in R^n, compute linear combinations and spans, and translate a vector equation into a linear system.
topics.focus_zh: $R^n$ 中向量的运算、线性组合与张成空间 Span，以及向量方程与线性方程组互译。
steps: Add vectors and multiply by scalars componentwise; interpret u + v by the parallelogram rule.
To test whether b lies in Span{a1,...,ap}, set up x1*a1 + ... + xp*ap = b.
Row reduce [a1 ... ap | b]; b is a linear combination iff this system is consistent.
Read the weights from the RREF; describe Span{u} (a line through 0) and Span{u,v} (a plane through 0) geometrically.
topics.note: 向量方程 $x_1a_1+...+x_na_n=b$ 与增广矩阵 $[a_1...a_n|b]$ 同解；张成空间是所有线性组合的集合。几何：单个向量的张成是过原点直线，两个不共线向量张成过原点平面，三个不共面向量张成 $R^3$。
topics.trap: Putting the vectors as rows instead of columns when forming the augmented matrix; claiming b is in a span without checking consistency; treating a span as a finite list of vectors.
topics.trap_zh: 写增广矩阵时把向量放成行而非列（应作为列 $a_i$）；未验证相容性就断言 $b$ 属于张成空间；把张成空间当成有限个向量而不是无限集合。
topics.question_hint: Compute vector sums / scalar multiples; convert a vector equation to a system and back; decide whether b is a linear combination of a1, a2, a3; find h so that b lies in a spanned plane.

topics.focus: Compute the matrix-vector product Ax, read it as a linear combination of the columns of A, and apply the equivalent conditions of Theorem 4.
topics.focus_zh: 计算矩阵-向量积 $Ax$、理解为 $A$ 的列以 $x$ 为权重的线性组合，并应用 Theorem 4 的等价命题判断存在性。
steps: Check dimensions first: A is m x n and x is in R^n, so Ax is defined and lies in R^m.
Compute Ax as x1*a1 + ... + xn*an (linear combination of the columns), or by taking dot products of each row of A with x.
Rewrite Ax = b as [A | b] and row reduce to test consistency.
Use Theorem 4: Ax = b has a solution for every b iff A has a pivot in EVERY ROW iff the columns of A span R^m.
topics.note: $Ax$ 的线性性质：$A(u+v)=Au+Av$、$A(cu)=c(Au)$。Theorem 4 等价命题：(a) 对每个 $b$ 方程有解；(b) 每个 $b$ 都是 $A$ 的列的线性组合；(c) 列张成 $R^m$；(d) $A$ 每行都有主元位置。存在性要求每行有主元，不是每列（每列是唯一性）。
topics.trap: Multiplying when the inner dimensions disagree; or concluding Ax = b is always solvable because A has a pivot in every column (that controls uniqueness, not existence).
topics.trap_zh: 内维不匹配仍强行相乘；误把「每列有主元」当成 $Ax=b$ 对任意 $b$ 有解的条件（那是唯一性；存在性要求每行有主元）。
topics.question_hint: Compute Ax; decide whether a product is defined; write a linear combination as A times a vector; judge True/False statements of Theorem 4 (columns spanning R^m, consistency for every b).

topics.focus: Describe homogeneous systems Ax = 0 (trivial vs nontrivial solutions) and the parametric vector form of solution sets of Ax = b.
topics.focus_zh: 齐次方程组 $Ax=0$ 的平凡解与非平凡解、齐次/非齐次解集的参数向量形式（通解 = 特解 + 齐次解）。
steps: For Ax = 0, row reduce [A | 0]; nontrivial solutions exist iff there is at least one free variable.
Write the solution in parametric vector form x = t*u + s*v, with the free variables as parameters.
For a consistent Ax = b, find one particular solution p (set all free variables to 0).
The general solution is w = p + v_h, where v_h is any solution of Ax = 0; geometrically it is a translate of the homogeneous solution set.
topics.note: 齐次方程 $Ax=0$ 必有平凡解 $x=0$；有非平凡解等价于有自由变量，也等价于 $A$ 的列线性相关。非齐次解集是 $p$ 加上齐次解空间，即沿 $p$ 平移（translation），一般不过原点。由线性性质可验证 $A(p+v_h)=b$。
topics.trap: Writing only the homogeneous solution and omitting the particular solution p; or claiming Ax = 0 has only the trivial solution while a free variable exists.
topics.trap_zh: 通解只写齐次解、漏掉特解 $p$；存在自由变量时仍断言 $Ax=0$ 只有平凡解；把非齐次解集误认为过原点的子空间。
topics.question_hint: Decide whether a homogeneous system has nontrivial solutions; write the parametric vector form; find a parameter g or h from a homogeneous solution; describe the solution set geometrically (a line / plane not through the origin).

topics.focus: Model applied problems (network flow, balancing chemical equations, static equilibrium) as linear systems and solve them.
topics.focus_zh: 把网络流、化学方程式配平、投入产出等应用问题建模为线性方程组并求解。
steps: Assign a variable to each unknown quantity (flow on each branch, coefficient of each molecule).
Write one conservation / balance equation at each node (flow in = flow out) or for each element.
Form the augmented matrix, row reduce to RREF and express the general solution with free variables.
Impose nonnegativity / feasibility constraints on the parameters and interpret the result.
topics.note: 课件暂缺，考点名称依据教材目录；题目待补充。本节点 focus/steps/trap 为依据教材 1.6 (Applications of Linear Systems) 标准内容的推定，非课件确认；实际教学范围请与 team-lead 核对。
topics.trap: Ignoring conservation at one node, or dropping the nonnegativity constraints on the flows.
topics.trap_zh: 课件暂缺。常见错误：遗漏某个节点的守恒方程；忽略流量或系数非负的约束。
topics.question_hint: Expected (no questions yet): build a linear system from a network-flow or chemical-balance word problem, solve it, and interpret the free parameters.

topics.focus: Determine whether a set of vectors is linearly independent or dependent, find dependence relations, and apply the special-case theorems.
topics.focus_zh: 判断向量组线性无关/相关、求线性相关关系，并应用特殊情形判定定理。
steps: Set up x1*v1 + ... + xp*vp = 0 and form [v1 ... vp | 0].
Row reduce; the set is linearly independent iff the ONLY solution is the trivial one (no free variables, a pivot in every column).
If dependent, solve for the nontrivial weights to write an explicit dependence relation such as 10v1 - 5v2 + 5v3 = 0.
Use shortcuts: two vectors are dependent iff one is a multiple of the other; any set containing the zero vector is dependent (Theorem 9); in R^n any set with p > n vectors is dependent.
topics.note: 矩阵列向量线性无关等价于 $Ax=0$ 只有平凡解，也等价于 $A$ 每列都有主元。定理：$R^n$ 中向量个数 $p>n$ 必线性相关；含零向量必相关；两向量相关等价于成比例。线性相关只保证「至少一个」向量是其余向量的线性组合，不一定是最后一个。
topics.trap: Applying determinant reasoning to non-square matrices; forgetting that a set with more vectors than entries is automatically dependent; assuming the last vector must be a combination of the others.
topics.trap_zh: 对非方阵谈行列式；忽略 $p>n$ 必相关、含零向量必相关这两个快速判定；误以为最后一个向量一定是其余向量的线性组合。
topics.question_hint: Judge linear independence by inspection; find a parameter h making a set dependent; find a linear dependence relation; prove a subset of an independent set is independent (True/False).

topics.focus: Understand a transformation T: R^n -> R^m, compute images under a matrix transformation T(x) = Ax, and verify linearity.
topics.focus_zh: 变换/映射的定义域、陪域、像与值域；矩阵变换 $T(x)=Ax$ 求像与原像；线性性质与叠加原理。
steps: From the size of A (m x n), identify domain R^n and codomain R^m.
Compute the image of u as T(u) = Au.
To find x with T(x) = b, row reduce [A | b]; inconsistency means b is outside the range.
Verify linearity via T(u+v) = T(u) + T(v) and T(cu) = c*T(u), equivalently the superposition rule T(cu + dv) = c*T(u) + d*T(v).
topics.note: 像 image 是 $T(x)$，值域 range 是所有像的集合，等于 $A$ 的列的全部线性组合（即列空间）。线性变换必满足 $T(0)=0$ 且保持加法与数乘（叠加原理 superposition）。几何：剪切 shear 把单位正方形映成平行四边形。
topics.trap: Confusing the image of a single vector with the whole range; treating T(x) = Ax + b with b != 0 as linear; mixing up domain (R^n) and codomain (R^m).
topics.trap_zh: 把单个向量的像当成整个值域；误认为 $T(x)=Ax+b$（$b$ 非零）是线性变换（此时 $T(0)$ 非零）；把定义域与陪域的维数搞反。
topics.question_hint: Find T(u) for a given u; find x whose image is b; decide whether a rule is a linear transformation; identify m and n from the standard matrix (fill-in); describe a shear.

topics.en: The Matrix of a Linear Transformation
topics.focus: Find the standard matrix A of a linear transformation, write matrices of geometric transformations, and decide onto / one-to-one.
topics.focus_zh: 求线性变换的标准矩阵、写出常见几何变换矩阵，并判断满射 onto 与单射 one-to-one。
steps: Compute the images of the standard basis vectors and set A = [T(e1) T(e2) ... T(en)] (Theorem 10); the standard matrix is unique.
For a geometric map (reflection, projection, rotation, contraction/dilation, shear), read T(e1) and T(e2) off the geometry and assemble A.
T is onto iff A has a pivot in EVERY ROW (columns span R^m); when n < m it cannot be onto.
T is one-to-one iff A has a pivot in EVERY COLUMN (columns independent, Ax = 0 has only the trivial solution); when n > m it cannot be one-to-one.
topics.note: Theorem 10：线性 $T$ 存在唯一 $A$ 使 $T(x)=Ax$，且 $A$ 的各列就是 $T(e_1),...,T(e_n)$。旋转矩阵为 $[[cos(t),-sin(t)],[sin(t),cos(t)]]$。对 $n$ 阶方阵由 IMT：onto 与 one-to-one 等价。
topics.trap: Placing T(e_i) as rows instead of columns of A; confusing onto (pivot in every ROW) with one-to-one (pivot in every COLUMN); using the wrong rotation direction.
topics.trap_zh: 求标准矩阵时把 $T(e_i)$ 放成行而非列；混淆 onto（每行有主元）与 one-to-one（每列有主元）；旋转矩阵的正负号写反。
topics.question_hint: Find the standard matrix of a dilation / reflection / rotation / projection; decide whether T is onto, one-to-one, both or neither; fill in m and n for T: R^m -> R^n.

topics.focus: Perform matrix addition, scalar multiplication, multiplication AB, powers and transposes, and know where matrix algebra differs from scalar algebra.
topics.focus_zh: 矩阵加法、数乘、乘法 $AB$、幂、转置与对称矩阵，以及矩阵运算与标量运算的差异。
steps: Add / scalar-multiply only matrices of equal size, entry by entry.
For AB check #cols(A) = #rows(B); entry (i,j) is the dot product of row i of A with column j of B, and column j of AB equals A*(column j of B).
Take powers A^k only for square A; transpose with (A^T)_ij = a_ji.
Remember (AB)^T = B^T A^T and (AB)^-1 = B^-1 A^-1; in general AB != BA and cancellation AB = AC => B = C fails.
topics.note: 对角矩阵（非对角元为 0）、零矩阵、单位矩阵 $I_n$、上/下三角矩阵。Theorem 1 加法运算律、Theorem 2 乘法结合律与分配律。$A$ 对称等价于 $A^T=A$。Warnings：$AB$ 一般不等于 $BA$；消去律不成立；$AB=0$ 不蕴含 $A=0$ 或 $B=0$。
topics.trap: Assuming AB = BA; cancelling a common left factor; computing AB with mismatched inner dimensions; writing (AB)^T = A^T B^T.
topics.trap_zh: 默认 $AB=BA$、随意消去公共因子；内维不匹配仍计算 $AB$；转置乘积忘记反序 $(AB)^T=B^TA^T$；误以为 $AB=0$ 能推出某个因子为零矩阵。
topics.question_hint: Compute AB, A + B, kA; decide whether a product is defined and give its size; compute A^T and powers; judge True/False about AB = BA, cancellation and (AB)^T.

topics.focus: Decide whether a square matrix is invertible, compute A^-1 (2x2 formula or row reduction), and use it to solve Ax = b.
topics.focus_zh: 判断方阵可逆（可逆/奇异/非奇异）、用 2x2 公式或行化简求逆矩阵，并用逆矩阵解 $Ax=b$。
steps: For A = [[a,b],[c,d]], if ad - bc != 0 then A^-1 = (1/(ad-bc)) * [[d,-b],[-c,a]]; otherwise A is singular (Theorem 4).
For larger A, row reduce [A | I]; if it becomes [I | A^-1] then A is invertible, otherwise no inverse exists (Theorem 7).
Verify A*A^-1 = A^-1*A = I.
If A is invertible, Ax = b has the UNIQUE solution x = A^-1 b (Theorem 5); elementary matrices encode each row operation used.
topics.note: 可逆 invertible / 非奇异 nonsingular；不可逆 = 奇异 singular。初等矩阵是对单位阵做一次初等行变换所得，左乘 $E$ 等价于对 $A$ 做同样行变换。Theorem 6：逆的逆是自身、$(AB)^{-1}=B^{-1}A^{-1}$、$(A^T)^{-1}=(A^{-1})^T$。求逆算法：$[A|I]$ 化为 $[I|A^{-1}]$。
topics.trap: Forgetting the 1/(ad-bc) factor; writing (AB)^-1 = A^-1 B^-1 instead of B^-1 A^-1; applying the 2x2 formula to a non-square matrix.
topics.question_hint: Compute a 2x2 inverse; decide invertibility from ad - bc or pivot count; find A^-1 by reducing [A | I]; solve Ax = b using A^-1; prove the three properties of Theorem 6.

topics.focus: Apply the Invertible Matrix Theorem (IMT) to decide invertibility of a square matrix from any one of its equivalent statements.
topics.focus_zh: 应用可逆矩阵定理 IMT 的等价陈述，从任意一条判断方阵可逆性。
steps: For a square n x n matrix A, recall the equivalent statements: A invertible; A row equivalent to I_n; A has n pivots; Ax = 0 has only the trivial solution; columns independent / spanning R^n; Ax = b solvable (uniquely) for each b; A^T invertible; det A != 0; T(x) = Ax one-to-one and onto.
Pick the cheapest condition to test, usually the pivot count or whether Ax = 0 has a nontrivial solution.
Conclude by equivalence: if one statement holds, all hold; if one fails, all fail.
Use the corollary: for square A, B, if AB = I then both are invertible and B = A^-1; for rectangular matrices CA = I_n or AD = I_m only force m = n when both hold.
topics.note: 课件首页标题为 CHARACTERIZATIONS OF INVERSE MATRICES，教材标准名是 Characterizations of Invertible Matrices（Theorem 8 / IMT）。$AB=I$（方阵）可推出 $A,B$ 均可逆且互为逆。IMT 只对方阵成立；长方阵的 $CA=I_n$、$AD=I_m$ 分别只说明列无关、行满秩。
topics.trap: Applying IMT to a non-square matrix; assuming AB = I forces invertibility for rectangular A, B; treating one-to-one and onto as equivalent for rectangular matrices.
topics.trap_zh: 把 IMT 用到非方阵；把长方阵的 $CA=I_n$ 或 $AD=I_m$ 误当成可逆（需 $m=n$ 且两者同时成立）；对长方阵把 one-to-one 与 onto 混为一谈。
topics.question_hint: Judge which IMT statements are equivalent (True/False); prove invertibility from A^2 - 2A + 5I = 0; decide one-to-one / onto; handle proofs with CA = I_n, AD = I_m and m = n.

topics.focus: Add, scalar-multiply and multiply partitioned (block) matrices, and use the column-row expansion of AB.
topics.focus_zh: 分块矩阵的加法、数乘与乘法，以及 $AB$ 的列-行展开（Theorem 10）。
steps: Partition A and B so that the COLUMN partition of A matches the ROW partition of B.
Add / scalar-multiply blockwise when both matrices are partitioned identically.
Multiply blockwise as (AB)_ij = sum_k A_ik * B_kj, keeping the order of the blocks (blocks are matrices, so order matters).
Use the column-row expansion AB = col1(A)*row1(B) + ... + coln(A)*rown(B) (Theorem 10).
topics.note: 分块矩阵 partitioned / block matrix；子矩阵 submatrix。关键：把 $A$ 看作列向量组、$B$ 看作行向量组；分块乘法要求 $A$ 的列分块与 $B$ 的行分块一致。本节点在课件 MTH028 2.3, 2.4.pdf 的 p32-p42：首页只列了 2.3，但 2.4 内容完整存在，不属于课件缺失。
topics.trap: Reversing the order of block products (matrix multiplication is not commutative); using incompatible partitions; treating blocks as scalars when adding matrices of different shapes.
topics.trap_zh: 分块乘法时颠倒块乘积顺序（矩阵乘法不交换）；分块方式不匹配仍强行相乘。
topics.question_hint: Compute a product of partitioned matrices; add / scalar-multiply blocks; apply the column-row expansion of AB (Theorem 10).

topics.focus: Factor a matrix as A = LU and use the factorization to solve Ax = b efficiently.
topics.focus_zh: 矩阵的 $LU$ 分解，并利用分解高效求解 $Ax=b$。
steps: Row reduce A to an echelon form U using only row replacements (no row interchanges).
Record the row-replacement multipliers in a unit lower-triangular L so that A = L U.
To solve Ax = b, first solve L y = b by forward substitution, then U x = y by back substitution.
If a row interchange is required, include a permutation matrix P and factor P A = L U.
topics.note: 课件暂缺，考点名称依据教材目录；题目待补充。本节点 focus/steps/trap 依据教材 2.5 (Matrix Factorizations) 标准内容推定，非课件确认。
topics.trap: Omitting the permutation matrix P when a row interchange is needed; writing A = U L instead of L U.
topics.trap_zh: 课件暂缺。常见错误：需要行交换时未引入置换矩阵 $P$；把 $A=LU$ 写成 $A=UL$。
topics.question_hint: Expected (no questions yet): find an LU factorization; solve Ax = b via forward and back substitution; explain why an echelon form without row scaling produces L.

topics.zh: 列昂惕夫投入产出模型
topics.focus: Set up and solve the Leontief input-output model (I - C)x = d for the production levels of an economy.
topics.focus_zh: 建立并求解列昂惕夫投入产出模型 $(I-C)x=d$，求各部门产出水平。
steps: Build the consumption matrix C, where c_ij is the input from sector i needed per unit of output of sector j.
Write the balance equation x = C x + d, i.e. (I - C) x = d, with d the final demand vector.
Solve (I - C) x = d by row reduction (or via (I - C)^-1 when it exists).
Interpret the nonnegative production vector x and check that all its entries are >= 0.
topics.note: 课件暂缺，考点名称依据教材目录；题目待补充。本节点 focus/steps/trap 依据教材 2.6 (The Leontief Input-Output Model) 标准内容推定，非课件确认。
topics.trap: Writing x = C x - d instead of x = C x + d; ignoring the conditions for (I - C) to be invertible and for x to be nonnegative.
topics.trap_zh: 课件暂缺。常见错误：把 $x=Cx+d$ 写成 $x=Cx-d$；忽略 $(I-C)$ 可逆与产出非负的条件。
topics.question_hint: Expected (no questions yet): build (I - C)x = d from a consumption matrix and final demand; compute the production vector x; interpret the result.

topics.zh: 计算机图形学中的应用
topics.focus: Represent geometric transformations in computer graphics with homogeneous coordinates and composite transformation matrices.
topics.focus_zh: 用齐次坐标与复合变换矩阵表示计算机图形学中的平移、旋转、缩放等几何变换。
steps: Represent a point (x, y) in homogeneous coordinates as (x, y, 1).
Write translations, rotations, scalings and shears as 3x3 homogeneous-coordinate matrices.
Compose transformations by multiplying the matrices in the correct (right-to-left) order.
Apply the composite matrix to every vertex of the figure to obtain the transformed image.
topics.note: 课件暂缺，考点名称依据教材目录；题目待补充。本节点 focus/steps/trap 依据教材 2.7 (Applications to Computer Graphics) 标准内容推定，非课件确认。注意：平移不是 $R^2$ 上的线性变换（$T(0)$ 非零），必须借助齐次坐标提升到 $R^3$ 用 3x3 矩阵表示。

topics.focus: Verify subspaces of R^n, find spanning sets and bases for Col A and Nul A, and relate kernel/range to linear transformations.
topics.focus_zh: 判断 $R^n$ 的子空间、求列空间与零空间的生成集与基，并把核/值域与线性变换联系起来。
steps: Check the three subspace conditions: 0 is in H, H is closed under u + v, and H is closed under c*u.
For Nul A, solve Ax = 0 and write the general solution as a linear combination of vectors weighted by the free variables; those vectors form a basis for Nul A.
For Col A, row reduce A and take the PIVOT COLUMNS OF THE ORIGINAL A as a basis (Theorem 13).
From the size m x n of A, Nul A is a subspace of R^n and Col A is a subspace of R^m; identify Nul A = ker T and Col A = range T.
Apply the Spanning Set Theorem: remove from S any vector that is a linear combination of the others to get a basis for H = Span(S).
topics.note: 子空间三条件：含零向量、加法封闭、数乘封闭；张成空间必为子空间。标准基 $e_1,...,e_n$。基等于线性无关且张成 $H$。Theorem 13：$A$ 的主元列构成列空间的基（取原矩阵 $A$ 的列，不是 RREF 的列）。零空间是 $R^n$ 的子空间、列空间是 $R^m$ 的子空间。
topics.trap: Taking pivot columns from the RREF instead of the original A; claiming a set is a basis after checking only independence or only spanning; mixing up the dimensions of Nul A and Col A.
topics.trap_zh: 从 RREF 而非原矩阵 $A$ 取主元列作列空间的基；只验证线性无关或只验证张成就断言是基；混淆零空间与列空间所在的 $R^n$ / $R^m$ 维数。
topics.question_hint: Decide whether a set is a subspace; find a spanning set / basis for Nul A and Col A; fill in k such that Nul A is a subspace of R^k; apply the Spanning Set Theorem; True/False on bases.
